answer_1.quote: We choose three meta evaluation benchmarks covering multilingual and multimodal scenarios... WMT22 Metrics Shared Task includes the generated sentences... SummEval summaries generated by each of the 16 models... PASCAL-50S ... a triple collection ... each instance consists of one reference and two captions.
models: various NLG systems (MT, summarization, captioning models)

answer_2.quote: We evaluate a variety of automatic metrics covering different categories... BLEU, ROUGE-1/2/L, METEOR, CIDEr, SPICE, BERTScore, MoverScore, BLEURT, Prism, COMET, BARTScore, GEMBA-Dav3-DA, ChatGPT-eval.

answer_3.quote: We also employ another excellent GPT 3.5 to judge whether the generated sentence conveys the same meaning of given reference... LLM-based metric ChatGPT-eval ...
methods: pairwise semantic equivalence judgment via prompt "Do sentence 1 and sentence 2 convey the same meaning?"

answer_4.quote: Human experts to rate these sentences via the multidimensional quality metrics (MQM) schema... Human judgements measure these summaries in terms of coherence, consistency, fluency, and relevance... Human annotators compare the two captions based on the reference and express their preference.
answer_4.guideline: Human raters evaluate generated outputs using criteria such as fluency, coherence, consistency, relevance, and preference between captions.
